content: A {{service}} subscription for more than {{count}} users is available upon request.

comment.text: Informational note in the subscription plan panel regarding custom enterprise-level subscriptions. The {{service}} variable refers to the product name, and {{count}} represents the user limit threshold.

usage.context:
<Text
 fontSize="14px"
 fontWeight={600}
 className={styles.uponRequestNote}
 >
 {t("DocsConnect:UsersUponRequest", {
 count: MAX_USERS,
 service: t("DocsConnect:DocsConnect"),
 })}
 </Text>
 </>
